title: Mitchell's Sunflowers
description: Add in better sunflowers, more variety.
body:
This mod adds in better sunflowers to Minecraft, the common sunflower any many others. Mod is in beta currently.

# Culvars
- Chocolate Cherry Sunflower
- Italian White Sunflower
- Strawberry Blonde Sunflower
- Torch Sunflower
- Midnight Rogue
- Valentine

Showcase: [here](https://youtu.be/L8mtSfC6FBA?si=KVw94u-_mAsPBcgx)

![A screenshot of different variants.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/kn6L4f4t/images/7685697fcec596b764c907c5608167d1d612715b.png)
